title: Shamshi-Adad IV conquers Assur
summary: Shamshi-Adad IV takes Assur and the throne of Assyria.
description: Shamshi-Adad IV takes Assur and the throne of Assyria. Recorded from a CFAH OSF preprint anchor point (not yet published in ARJ). Added by the CFAH pass.
